author: KeewiDood
body:
Age: 12
Timezone: CET
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: Yes.
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes.
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes.

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? No, I have never been a staff member on any other server. 

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?  A small weakness i might have is my English accent. Sometimes it might be hard to understand since i have the Swedish accent. My biggest strength is talking. I am pretty good at talking. If someone doesn't agree I can pretty easily get them to understand what the truth is etc.


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team? I can, for the most part, improve the staff team with my crazy activity schedule. As you can see on the activity board this last week, I have been on for the fourth most time, even though I have been skiing this whole week. I can also help in catching hackers, checking forums, moderating chat (i already do all of it) etc.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why? A leader should make it fair for everyone, they should not make unfair advantages for the people they like. Leaders should choose what is best for the team, the leader should not be immature, promote immaturity etc. To be a leader I think that you should be mature, in a situation you should look at both sides of the consequence. You should always tell the truth, you should punish people out of what they do etc. I do not consider myself to be a leader right now. 


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?
I can keep myself calm and collected while expressing any message in a simple way. I know that I am one of the most active players in-game & on forums. I moderator chat, report hackers and such things that a moderator do all the time. If I do something wrong, I won't lie about it and blame it on someone else, the same if I do a mistake. I will take responsibility for everything I do. I definitely think I can improve this whole server, on whatever platform and I will do whatever I can to do that. I know that avicus barely has any active European staff members, that's where i come in. I am the most active player in this time-zone.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? I believe that you should have a common sense when interacting with the community. You should look at all the sides of any consequence you come across. If someone in the community doesn't understand a lot of English I will try my best of my ability to try getting them to understand. 
I do believe I have all the skills that are needed to speak with the overall community.



How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? I can commit all my free time into being a staff member if that's what needed. 


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do? First, I would get evidence of him hacking, then I would try freezing him every time he comes online. I would contact another staff member with the permissions to ban and keep doing it until he/she gets on.


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However, the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do? If I knew that the leaders of that team didn't want him there, I would ask him myself with maybe my power as another staff member I could get him out of there. If he still resists leaving after that, I would either wait until an Official comes online, tell them what this Referee has been doing and see if he'd do anything about it. 


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realize that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do? Firstly I want to say that this would never happen to me, I store my evidence both on my computer, and I also upload the evidence to some website online, but if I didn't have the evidence file, or no one else had it I would have to accept the appeal because I don't have the evidence. 

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? I would ask this staff member if he was aware that he had posted this thread that only staff members were able to see. If he wasn't aware of that and he deleted his post, I wouldn't do anything about it because I still wouldn't have any evidence of doing this, neither was it that important. If he was aware of it, I would ask him to take it down because only staff members were supposed to see it but if he didn't take it down I would take a further action and talk to his mentor or anyone who is over him. If he's the admin I wouldn't really be able to do anything about it I don't think.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However, you do not like the decision based on what you know. What would you do? If I was a moderator I think I would simply accept what decisions they make and not really question it. If I felt like questioning it at that moment I probably would.


CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you? It would mean almost everything to me since I use all my free time playing Minecraft and Avicus is the only server I really play on except for my survival world I would be super happy! 


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?
As I said in a previous question, Avicus is everything, I'm always on it, in the forums, TeamSpeak, discord. Avicus is my life. If I would be banned I would be really sad and not quite sure what to do.

Do you speak any other languages than English? Yes, I am from Sweden. I do have an accent but I do know how to pronounce and write most words in English. 


Do you have anything else to add to your application? Nothing except that I'm a really active player. As I wrote before I have been skiing and I'm still the fourth most active player this past week. ( https://avicus.net/stats?utf8=%E2%9C%93&period=weekly&sort=time_online&query= ) I also do online reports everytime I see a hacker if no staff are online. I am also aware that Avicus needs more European staff,  that's where i am the most activest.


Edits:

- Changed the first question under Criteria 2. - you can't glitch through the freeze anymore apparently - 2017/03/04

- Changed a LOT of grammar fails - 2017/03/04

-  Added a weakness - 2017/03/06

- Changed more grammar fails - 2017/03/06

- Added a thing about activity in my timezone - 2017/03/06

replies.author: JDKL
replies.body:
[Denied] - I am sorry to say your application has been denied.

Here are the reasons why:

- Overall Behavior on the network needs to improve. We suggest that if you are interested in becoming Mod, you need to improve your behavior and attitude on all Avicus platforms.

You may not submit another application.
